title: ARGOS — AI Evaluation & Continuous Assurance
status: VOCE public continuous-assurance framework; not a certification scheme
purpose: Keep institutional AI and agent systems within an evidence-backed operating envelope as models, prompts, tools, permissions, data, suppliers and human conditions change.

assurance_cycle.name: Baseline
assurance_cycle.question: What exact model, prompt, tool, permission, data and policy configuration is in production?

fr.name: Référence initiale
fr.question: Quel modèle, prompt, outil, jeu de permissions, donnée et politique exacts sont en production?

it.name: Baseline
it.question: Quali modello, prompt, strumento, permessi, dati e policy esatti sono in produzione?

assurance_cycle.name: Observe
assurance_cycle.question: What is the deployed system actually doing across tasks, tools, costs, errors, approvals and human interventions?

fr.name: Observer
fr.question: Que fait réellement le système déployé sur les tâches, outils, coûts, erreurs, validations et interventions humaines?

it.name: Osservare
it.question: Che cosa fa realmente il sistema implementato tra task, strumenti, costi, errori, approvazioni e interventi umani?

assurance_cycle.name: Detect change
assurance_cycle.question: Which material change, drift, incident or supplier event invalidates the previous assurance state?

fr.name: Détecter le changement
fr.question: Quel changement matériel, dérive, incident ou événement fournisseur invalide l’état d’assurance précédent?

it.name: Rilevare il cambiamento
it.question: Quale modifica sostanziale, drift, incidente o evento del fornitore invalida lo stato di assurance precedente?

assurance_cycle.name: Re-evaluate
assurance_cycle.question: Which evaluations, security tests, conformance controls and cognitive controls must be repeated after the change?

fr.name: Réévaluer
fr.question: Quelles évaluations, tests de sécurité, contrôles Conformance et contrôles cognitifs doivent être répétés après le changement?

it.name: Rivalutare
it.question: Quali valutazioni, test di sicurezza, controlli Conformance e controlli cognitivi devono essere ripetuti dopo il cambiamento?

assurance_cycle.name: Compare
assurance_cycle.question: How does the new system state differ from the accepted baseline on quality, safety, authority, cost and human oversight?

fr.name: Comparer
fr.question: Comment le nouvel état diffère-t-il de la référence acceptée sur qualité, sécurité, autorité, coût et supervision humaine?

it.name: Confrontare
it.question: In che modo il nuovo stato differisce dalla baseline accettata su qualità, sicurezza, autorità, costo e supervisione umana?

assurance_cycle.name: Decide
assurance_cycle.question: Can the changed system remain in service, require restrictions, rollback, additional approval or withdrawal?

fr.name: Décider
fr.question: Le système modifié peut-il rester en service, doit-il être restreint, revenir en arrière, exiger une validation supplémentaire ou être retiré?

it.name: Decidere
it.question: Il sistema modificato può restare in servizio, deve essere limitato, riportato indietro, richiedere un’approvazione aggiuntiva o essere ritirato?

assurance_cycle.name: Retain evidence
assurance_cycle.question: Can the institution reconstruct why the system was considered acceptable at that point in time?

fr.name: Conserver les preuves
fr.question: L’institution peut-elle reconstruire pourquoi le système était considéré comme acceptable à cet instant?

it.name: Conservare le evidenze
it.question: L’istituzione può ricostruire perché il sistema era considerato accettabile in quel momento?

assurance_cycle.name: Re-open
assurance_cycle.question: What future event automatically reopens assurance rather than waiting for a periodic audit?

fr.name: Rouvrir
fr.question: Quel événement futur rouvre automatiquement l’assurance au lieu d’attendre un audit périodique?

it.name: Riaprire
it.question: Quale evento futuro riapre automaticamente l’assurance invece di attendere un audit periodico?

fr.name: Changement de modèle de fondation ou de version majeure

it.name: Cambio di foundation model o di versione principale

triggers.name: Prompt, system instruction or orchestration-policy change

fr.name: Changement de prompt, d’instruction système ou de politique d’orchestration

it.name: Modifica di prompt, istruzione di sistema o policy di orchestrazione

triggers.name: New tool, API, MCP server or A2A peer

fr.name: Nouvel outil, API, serveur MCP ou pair A2A

it.name: Nuovo strumento, API, server MCP o peer A2A

fr.name: Changement de permissions, limites transactionnelles ou seuils d’approbation

it.name: Modifica di permessi, limiti transazionali o soglie di approvazione

triggers.name: New data source, RAG index, memory mechanism or processing region

fr.name: Nouvelle source de données, index RAG, mécanisme de mémoire ou région de traitement

it.name: Nuova fonte dati, indice RAG, meccanismo di memoria o regione di elaborazione

triggers.name: Material degradation in task quality or error distribution

fr.name: Dégradation matérielle de la qualité des tâches ou de la distribution des erreurs

it.name: Degrado sostanziale della qualità dei task o della distribuzione degli errori

triggers.name: Security incident, prompt-injection event or material near miss

fr.name: Incident de sécurité, injection de prompt ou quasi-incident matériel

it.name: Incidente di sicurezza, prompt injection o near miss rilevante

triggers.name: Supplier, licence, pricing or availability change

fr.name: Changement de fournisseur, licence, prix ou disponibilité

it.name: Cambio di fornitore, licenza, prezzo o disponibilità

triggers.name: Regulatory role, classification or sector obligation change

fr.name: Changement de rôle réglementaire, classification ou obligation sectorielle

it.name: Cambio di ruolo regolatorio, classificazione o obbligo settoriale

triggers.name: Material increase in cost, retries or resource consumption

fr.name: Hausse matérielle des coûts, retries ou consommation de ressources

it.name: Aumento rilevante di costi, retry o consumo di risorse

triggers.name: Rise in human overrides, missed alerts, decision fatigue or cognitive-control failures

fr.name: Hausse des overrides humains, alertes manquées, fatigue décisionnelle ou échecs des contrôles cognitifs

it.name: Aumento di override umani, avvisi mancati, affaticamento decisionale o fallimenti dei controlli cognitivi

triggers.name: Significant organisational or staffing change affecting human oversight

fr.name: Changement organisationnel ou d’effectifs affectant matériellement la supervision humaine

it.name: Cambiamento organizzativo o di personale che incide materialmente sulla supervisione umana

assurance_states.name: Open
assurance_states.definition: A material trigger has occurred and the previous assurance conclusion cannot be relied upon without re-evaluation.

fr.name: Ouverte
fr.definition: Un déclencheur matériel est survenu et la conclusion précédente ne peut plus être utilisée sans réévaluation.

it.name: Aperta
it.definition: Si è verificato un trigger materiale e la precedente conclusione di assurance non può più essere utilizzata senza rivalutazione.

assurance_states.name: Restricted
assurance_states.definition: The system may operate only under explicit temporary limits while evidence gaps are closed.

fr.name: Restreinte
fr.definition: Le système ne peut fonctionner que sous limites temporaires explicites jusqu’à fermeture des lacunes de preuve.

it.name: Limitata
it.definition: Il sistema può operare solo sotto limiti temporanei espliciti finché le lacune di evidenza non vengono chiuse.

assurance_states.name: Accepted
assurance_states.definition: The defined evaluation and control set supports continued operation within the stated scope and conditions.

fr.name: Acceptée
fr.definition: L’ensemble défini d’évaluations et de contrôles soutient la poursuite de l’exploitation dans le périmètre et les conditions déclarés.

it.name: Accettata
it.definition: L’insieme definito di valutazioni e controlli sostiene la prosecuzione dell’operatività nello scope e nelle condizioni dichiarate.

assurance_states.name: Withdrawn
assurance_states.definition: The system or capability is removed from service because the evidence no longer supports continued operation.

fr.name: Retirée
fr.definition: Le système ou la capacité est retiré du service parce que les preuves ne soutiennent plus son maintien en exploitation.

it.name: Ritirata
it.definition: Il sistema o la capacità viene rimosso dal servizio perché le evidenze non supportano più la prosecuzione dell’operatività.

integrations.role: Defines the technical architecture and control surfaces.

integrations.role: Defines the human cognitive and neuropsychology assurance layer.
